assertion: Isolated controls for the backdrop/blend combination: invert alone filters the page before normal source-over content, while multiply alone blends foreground content with the original page.

browser.reason: Reviewed invert-only and multiply-only controls. Chrome shows both effects; Valle differs by only one output channel level in the translucent invert-only background (16000 pixels). Firefox/WebKit omit the backdrop inversion in this environment even without blending; see the backdrop-blend case README.
